title: SayCheck Test Suite
description: A set of utterances to play at a voice-enabled robot, grouped by scenario, with optional reference audio and expected behaviour.

id.description: Stable identifier. Used as the filename stem and as the foreign key in session records.

locale.description: BCP-47 language tag of the spoken text, e.g. ja-JP, en-US, zh-CN.

license.description: SPDX identifier for the suite content itself, e.g. MIT, CC-BY-4.0.

robot.description: Optional. Metadata only — SayCheck never connects to a device.

audioBase.description: Prefix prepended to every utterance audio.path. Relative to the suite file. Empty string means paths are absolute or relative to the page.

wake.description: Optional wake phrase played before each test phrase. Most voice devices need one; leaving this out means the test phrase is spoken cold.

audio.description: Relative path to the wake clip. Resolved against audioBase.

settleMs.description: Quiet gap after the wake clip before the test phrase starts.

label.description: Shown in the UI, e.g. 'Hey robot'.

weight.description: Optional. Higher weight contributes more to the overall score.

defaults.description: Per-suite defaults. A runner may override any of these from the UI. The shipped values come from real measurements on a service robot, not from guesses.

windowMs.description: How long to keep listening when nothing happens at all.

settleMs.description: Quiet gap after playback ends before audio is judged. Stops the clip's own tail from counting as a response.

silenceMs.description: After a hit, finish early once this long passes with no further sound or motion.

rmsPeakDb.description: dBFS peak that counts as 'it spoke'. -34 dBFS is linear RMS 0.02.

frameDiff.description: Mean frame difference that counts as 'it moved'. A still scene stays under 1; motion exceeds 3.

rule.description: any = sound OR motion counts as a response. motion = the robot must physically move. sound = it must make a sound.

judgeMode.description: manual = stop after every round and wait for a keypress. auto = accept the sensor verdict and move on, for unattended batch runs.

useWake.description: Whether the wake clip is played. Only meaningful when the suite defines `wake`.

groupId.description: Must match a groups[].id. Omit for ungrouped utterances.

translation.description: Translation into the reviewer's language, so a non-speaker can judge correctness.

path.description: Relative path to a wav/mp3/ogg file. Resolved against audioBase.

provider.description: Which TTS engine produced this clip: irodori, chatterbox, kokoro, human, ...

languageId.description: Language tag passed to the TTS engine when this clip was generated.

sha256.description: Checksum of the audio file. Guards against silent re-generation invalidating historical comparisons.

expect.description: Human-readable expectation. Deliberately NOT used by the automatic sensor verdict.

action.description: e.g. wave, handshake, nod, bow, none

tags.description: Free-form labels used for failure attribution, e.g. '5+ syllables', 'contains-number', 'keigo'.
